description: The data map's search box. Finds a tenement ("E 53/1209"), a WAMEX report ("A12345"), a drillhole id, a map sheet, a place name, or coordinates in decimal degrees ("-30.75, 121.47"), degrees-minutes-seconds ("30°45'S 121°28'12\"E") or MGA ("MGA51 352000 6600000"). Returns each match's kind, label, detail, lon/lat and bbox, with a map link that opens What's here on it. Companies and projects: search_owners.

q.description: What a reader would type in the map's search box.
